visual_identity.style_notes: Luxury + Tech. Think: Bloomberg terminal meets penthouse marketing. Clean, data-driven, authoritative.

voice_settings.voice_notes: Professional, authoritative but approachable. Not salesy. Think: trusted consultant briefing a CEO.
voice_settings.custom_voice_clone_notes: If you want to clone your own voice, record 30 minutes of clean audio and upload to ElevenLabs. Much more authentic.

video_settings.visual_track_notes: TSX = pure code animation (infographics, charts, diagrams). Best for educational/data content.

always_include: A specific pain point from luxury real estate
A visual metaphor the viewer can picture
An identity statement at the end
psychology_principles: Loss Aversion: Frame as what they're losing, not gaining
Curiosity Gap: Start with incomplete information
Social Proof: Reference what top developers do
Authority: Teach, let them conclude they need you
Identity: End with who they want to be
